notes.title: Comprehensive patch notes live on discord + Patch 0.6.9a
notes.notes:
I just pushed version 0.6.9a live.
Together with it, I also released the full patch notes, which were internal and unreleased since version 0.6.2 (MARCH 2025! EONS AGO!! DISHONOR TO MY FAMILY!).

The notes are kinda long and a mouthful, but they can be viewed and read on the official discord server.

To note: the patch notes for the full game will be readable here on the steam community, as well I plan to introduce in-game patch notes. For now, allow me to be brief here, and keep the lengthy notes on discord only.

No testing required until 0.7 as usual.

Thank you, have a good one.

Need to re-test portals on low FPS, performance.
Dev shortcuts still active.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.7.(dev) now live
notes.notes:
This is probably the last updates/changes for July.
The main change is the added menu to rebind the controls, both for mouse&keyboard and for controller.

Still some stuff I want to finish/add/redo before 0.7.0 and the next wave of playtesting.

Dev shortcuts are still active in this version (1 to save, 2 to load, 3 to delete).

Cheers,
-Aaron

notes.title: TOWST Playtest version clarification
notes.notes:
If you are reading this, you may have an early access to TOWST playtest on steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620348/998c350929a05ce4b0e30e271cf7e744859be78b.png[/img]

I will be releasing very minor fixes, aimed at testing certain settings or features in a environment that would much resemble a "released game" compared to testing things on my own machine.

I want it to be clear, I don't expect anyone with access to actually play this versions, not because you can't, but because unless I need something specific I won't need you to. Additionally, these versions will have the debug controls (1 to save, 2 to load, 3 to delete save files) activated, and there will be no boundaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620348/22d52e210a52f6647fcfa1006a1d7c37f93820ec.png[/img]

The goal is for me to add more and more stuff, and when I have added enough I will officially request you to test any new features.

I will use both discord and this steam news to let you know about any new development. Till then, thank you and I wish you a good weekend!
